question: Confirm ordinary two-nature level-65 builds can beat all four village bosses; make only a small difficulty reduction.
scope: Three existing group damage scales and Moonshadow65 signature power only. No engine, HP, stat, roster, ability identity, reward or later-boss changes.
evidenceTier: Deterministic production-resolver loadout simulations, not player win rates or a universal build guarantee.
preparation: Eight level-65 builds: four schools, balanced/focused earned point budgets; two owned natures Earth/Wind, six catalog techniques including area attacks, uncommon shop armor, mastery10; no weapon/pet/bloodline/consumable/reset. Heal below55% and use visible counters and utility. Real story AI policy and village biome.
policy: Visible-state counterplay, heal below55%. Group chip-finisher retained; Solo continues casting against a low-HP boss. No future-turn search or mid-fight resource changes.
